BrochureContent.Content:
Farrell Auctioneers, Valuers & Estate Agents Ltd are delighted to bring to the market this unique property set on approximately 1.68 acres of mature private grounds, complete with its own private tennis court, in an excellent location close to the vibrant town of Gort, Co. Galway.

Offering a rare combination of substantial grounds, an established tennis court and an architecturally distinctive residence, this property presents an exciting opportunity for purchasers seeking a substantial home with scope to renovate, modernise and create a residence tailored entirely to their own requirements.

The property has considerable character and architectural appeal, with exposed brickwork featuring throughout both the interior and exterior, generous proportions and large windows that allow excellent levels of natural light. While the existing accommodation is extensive, the property would benefit from a programme of modernisation, providing an exciting canvas for those looking to transform and personalise a substantial country residence.

The accommodation currently extends to five bedrooms and four bathrooms, together with a particularly generous selection of reception and living spaces. A welcoming entrance hall leads to a spacious lounge, dining room and den overlooking the grounds, while a billiard room and additional sitting room, complete with vaulted ceiling and expansive windows, further add to the property`s versatility and character. The kitchen and adjoining dining area provide a central hub to the existing accommodation, while the bedroom accommodation offers excellent flexibility for family living, guest accommodation, home working or future reconfiguration.

Step outside to your private oasis! One of the property`s stand out features is the approximately 1.68 acre site which offers an exceptional sense of space and privacy. The mature grounds feature a tennis court, making it perfect for outdoor entertaining, family activities, or simply unwinding in the serene countryside. The generous driveway offers ample parking and is surrounded by established landscaping and mature trees, enhancing the property`s charm. There is also the additional option of approx. 7.26 acres which surround the property. 

Located in the heart of Gort, this exceptional home is just a stone`s throw away from an array of amenities, including shops, restaurants, cafés, schools, sporting facilities, and convenient transport links. With excellent connectivity to Galway City and surrounding areas via the M18 motorway, this property is ideal for families and commuters alike.

The generous site and existing architectural features create scope for purchasers to consider a variety of renovation and design possibilities, making this a property that can be adapted to suit a wide range of lifestyles and requirements.
Properties offering this scale of grounds, a private tennis court and such distinctive architectural character rarely come to the market in the area. For those seeking a renovation project with the opportunity to create a truly individual home, this property offers an exciting proposition in an established and well-connected location.

Viewing is highly recommended to appreciate the scale, setting, architectural character and potential this property has to offer. To arrange an appointment, contact Farrell Auctioneers, Valuers & Estate Agents Ltd on 091 632688 or email colm@colmfarrell.com.
